rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for round parentheses, “(” and “)”.

example.english: Use a bracket around this term so people know which part to calculate first.
example.traditional: 要用括號括住呢一項，等人知先計邊部分。
example.jyutping: jiu3 jung6 kut3 hou6 kut3 zyu6 ni1 jat1 hong6 dang2 jan4 zi1 sin1 gai3 bin1 bou6 fan6

rows.note: Use this specifically for square brackets, “[” and “]”, rather than ordinary 括號.

example.english: You don't need to read the word inside the bracket aloud.
example.traditional: 方括號入面個字唔使讀出嚟。
example.jyutping: fong1 kut3 hou6 jap6 min6 go3 zi6 m4 sai2 duk6 ceot1 lei4

rows.note: Use this for a physical bracket or support attached to a wall to hold a shelf.

example.english: This shelf needs a bracket to hold it up securely.
example.traditional: 呢塊層板要用一個托架托住先穩陣。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 cang4 baan2 jiu3 jung6 jat1 go3 tok3 gaa2 tok3 zyu6 sin1 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Use this when the bracket means a category or band dividing ages, incomes, or other numerical ranges.

example.english: I fall into the middle-income bracket.
example.jyutping: ngo5 suk6 jyu1 zung1 dang2 sau1 jap6 zou2 bit6
